content: Official ExDoc v0.40.3 docs confirm :extras supports .md, .livemd, .cheatmd, external URL extras, and per-extra :filename/:title/:source/:search_data; :extra_section sets the sidebar section label; :groups_for_extras and :groups_for_modules organize sidebar content; :redirects maps extensionless old paths to extensionless targets and supports anchors; :source_ref defaults to main, source_url/source_ref infer GitHub source links without custom source_url_pattern for normal github.com; :logo and :favicon accept SVG when sizing attributes are present; :formatters defaults to html/markdown/epub but can be set explicitly. Changelog confirms Markdown formatter, default llms.txt generation, and redirect anchors in v0.40.0 plus favicon support in v0.37.0.
